articles.title: Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre Arrives in Jeddah for High-Level Strategic Talks
articles.titleSo: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre oo Gaaray Magaalada Jidda ee Sacuudi Carabiya
articles.summary: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre was received at King Abdulaziz International Airport by Jeddah Governor Prince Saud bin Abdullah bin Jalawi for bilateral talks.
articles.content:
JEDDAH — Prime Minister of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Hamza Abdi Barre, arrived in Jeddah today for strategic bilateral discussions with Saudi leadership.

He was officially welcomed at King Abdulaziz International Airport by Jeddah Governor Prince Saud bin Abdullah bin Jalawi alongside high-ranking diplomats. The visit focuses on expanding regional security partnerships, Red Sea maritime trade corridors, and economic cooperation between the Federal Republic of Somalia and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
articles.contentSo:
JEDDAH — Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u gaaray magaalada Jidda ee dalka Sacuudi Carabiya si uu u yeesho wada-hadallo heer sare ah.

Waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha ee Boqor Cabdulcasiis ku soo dhoweeyay Badhasaabka Jidda, Amiir Sacuud bin Cabdullah bin Jalawi. Booqashadan ayaa lagu xoojinayaa iskaashiga amniga, marinnada ganacsiga Badda Cas, iyo xiriirka dhaqaale ee ka dhexeeya labada dal.

articles.title: Somalia Issues Formal Diplomatic Statement Condemning Karak Church Attack in Jordan
articles.titleSo: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Cambaareysay Weerarkii ka Dhacay Gobolka Karak ee Dalka Urdun
articles.summary: The Federal Republic of Somalia joined international bodies in condemning the heinous violent incident in Jordan's Karak governorate.
articles.content:
MOGADISHU — The Federal Government of Somalia issued an official statement condemning the violence targeting civilian and religious institutions in Jordan's Karak governorate.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed full solidarity with the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, reinforcing Somalia's firm stance against extremism, international terror, and regional instability while offering condolences to affected families.
articles.contentSo:
MUQDISHO — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay bayaan rasmi ah oo ay ku cambaareynayso weerarkii ka dhacay gobolka Karak ee dalka Urdun.

Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa muujisay garab istaag buuxa oo ay u fidinayso dalka Urdun, iyada oo ku celisay maqaamka adag ee Soomaaliya ka joogto la dagaallanka xagjirinimada iyo falalka waxushtinimada ah.

articles.title: Somalia Commends Emergency Operations Following Eastleigh Building Collapse in Nairobi
articles.titleSo: Soomaaliya oo Ammaanatay Gurmadka ka Socda Dhismihii ku Dumay Xaafadda Eastleigh ee Nairobi
articles.summary: Somalia's Ambassador to Kenya commended joint rescue operations in Eastleigh as bilateral diplomatic teams visit affected sites.
articles.content:
NAIROBI — Ambassador Jabril Ibrahim Abdulle, Somalia's envoy to Kenya, commended the prompt joint response by rescue teams and Nairobi county officials following a structural building collapse in the Eastleigh district.

Ambassador Abdulle visited the site alongside local representatives, expressing sympathies and praising community volunteers and emergency personnel working round the clock.
articles.contentSo:
NAIROBI — Danjiraha Soomaaliya u fadhiya dalka Keniya, Jabril Ibraahim Cabdulle, ayaa ammaanay hawlgallada gurmadka ee ka socda xaafadda Eastleigh ee magaalada Nairobi ka dib markii uu halkaas ku dumay dhisme.

Danjiraha ayaa kormeeray goobta msibatadu ka dhacday, isaga oo bogaadiyay ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah iyo dadweynaha sida xiriirka ah uga qaybqaatay badbaadinta.

articles.title: Ankara & Horn Partners Advance Port Logistics & Energy Research Frameworks
articles.titleSo: Turkiya iyo Bahwadaagta Gobolka oo Horumariyay Iskaashiga Dhaqaalaha Baddaha iyo Tamarta
articles.summary: Bilateral technical committees finalize agreements on Red Sea maritime navigation security and port modernization.
articles.content:
ANKARA — Technical committees representing Turkiye and East African regional partners convened in Ankara to finalize joint infrastructure protocols for maritime security and deep-sea energy exploration.

The initiative establishes updated training programs for coast guard personnel and expands trade volume across major commercial sea routes connecting the Gulf of Aden and international ports.
articles.contentSo:
ANKARA — Guddiyada farsamada ee Turkiya iyo saaxiibada Bariga Afrika ayaa ku kulmay Ankara si ay u dhameystiraan heshiisyo habboon oo ku saabsan amniga baddaha iyo baaritaanka tamarta.

Heshiiskan ayaa bixin doona tababaro cusub oo lagu horumarinayo ilaalinta baddaha iyo kor u qaadista ganacsiga badda ee Gacanka Cadan.

articles.title: Somali Global Diaspora Network Launches Civic Innovation Initiative Across US & EU Cities
articles.titleSo: Shabakadda Jaaliyadaha Soomaaliyeed ee Caalamka oo Daah-furtay Barnaamijka Hal-abuurka Bulshada
articles.summary: Community leaders in North America and Europe launch new business development grants and youth mentorship platforms.
articles.content:
MINNEAPOLIS / LONDON — Diaspora leaders across major hubs in Minnesota, London, Toronto, and Columbus launched a combined initiative focused on economic empowerment and civic participation for young professionals.

The initiative introduces mentorship networks and seed funding for technological and business start-ups founded by diaspora entrepreneurs.
articles.contentSo:
MINNEAPOLIS / LONDON — Hiddaha iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha jaaliyadaha ee gobolka Minnesota, London, Toronto iyo Columbus ayaa daah-furay barnaamij wadajir ah oo loogu talagalay horumarinta ganacsiga iyo dhiirrigelinta dhallinyarada.

Barnaamijkan ayaa siin doona taageero maaliyadeed iyo tababaro ganacsi dhallinyarada ku nool qurba-joogta.
